full_judgment: 10. Mr Qamrul Islam Siddique, learned Advocate, submits that, the learned Additional District Judge, Khulna totally was in wrong presumption in rejecting the plaint of the suit on the ground that the suit is barred by amended provision of section 23A of the Specific Relief Act and section 17A of the Transfer of the Property Act as the learned Judge failed to consider the suit is not for specific performance of contract but this suit is for permanent injunction where the prime question is to determine possession, which is to be determined on taking evidence as such judgment and decree passed in Revision is liable to be set-aside.
